meta.name: Miracles of the ER
meta.description: A bold decision brings an average med student to an elite ER team, where he encounters medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and personal growth.

videos.title: The Misfit
videos.overview: As three new doctors start their first day at the busy Yang-Da ER, rookie Geng-ming struggles to perform a routine procedure on a famous patient.

videos.title: Room for Error
videos.overview: Yu-hua faces a malpractice mediation. Meanwhile, Hsi must decide whether to involve police after suspecting a patient of harming animals.
The doctors try to protect an injured teenage girl who is terrified of her father. Geng-ming comes to Hsi's aid when a patient steps out of line.

videos.title: A Doctor's Choice
videos.overview: Tung-yen's past resurfaces when a gangster enters the ER. As a cancer patient tries to leave to avoid costly bills, Hsi looks for a way to help him.

videos.title: Wishes and Last Wishes
videos.overview: The staff rally to help a widow secure a life insurance claim. Chou's confidence in his research is shaken when a rival releases conflicting findings.

videos.title: Good Doctor, Bad Doctor
videos.overview: When a migrant worker arrives at the ER, Geng-ming notices something off about his test results. Yu-hua faces intense scrutiny at the malpractice trial.

videos.title: Truth and Lies
videos.overview: The new head of the ER department causes problems for the staff and patients. A protest at the hospital quickly threatens to turn violent.

videos.title: The Relentless
videos.overview: After a mass stabbing on a city bus, the doctors try to cope with the influx of injured patients flooding into the ER — including the perpetrator.
